text_block_list.text:
Miraculously managing to get in shape in time...
North Flight's dream of running in the Oka Sho,
which she had spoken of with hope before, came true.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—We made it in time, but...
Barely, though.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The mile is where I can put on
my best performance...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I won't surrender
this radiance—to anyone in my generation!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So you came to the Tiara path...
Somehow, I had a feeling you would.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Because the sparkle of the Tiara... suits you so well, Flight-san!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san, who is so smart and stylish...
I saw how devotedly you worked hard.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Even someone that amazing goes through a lot. I gotta do my best too!"
...It really gave me courage.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It feels strange. When I'm with Flight-san,
I feel so relieved, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My heart gets all stirred up,
sayin' it don't wanna lose.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I thought my goal was
that dazzling girl over there, but..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'll be keeping a sharp eye
on Flight-san too!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much...
For truly... watching over me.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: A great radiance lies before us. But still!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Believe in yourself and clash with everything you've got!
—Together!
